relations.subject: Sitanath Acharya
relations.evidence: Prof. Sitanath Acharya (b. 1 December 1939-d. 28 October 2021) has passed away today at 6.05 A.M. He was an erudite scholar-poet, who retired from Calcutta University in 2004.
